name: Ollama Audit: llama3.2:1b (Baseline (Unprotected))
summary: Could not connect to Ollama Gateway at https://example.com. Probes were not dispatched to protect network integrity.

findings.title: Gateway Offline at https://example.com
findings.observed: Connection to https://example.com/models was refused or timed out.
findings.why_it_matters: Ollama local model security probes require an active gateway process.
findings.action: Ensure Ollama is running (`ollama serve`) and the gateway is running (`python ollama_gateway.py`).

next_steps: If assessing via cloud web app, tunnel port 8080 via ngrok (`ngrok http 8080`) or run ATLAS-Risk locally.
